Hi everyone!
I just read the #Nova > Getting started with nova contribution and #Nova > Good first issue and I realize that it might be hard for me to contribute the Nova now.

I'm still pretty new to Rust and Linux kernel development, so I'll probably start with Rust for Linux to build up some experience first.

I'd still like to follow Nova's development and get to know the community in the meantime.

Would reading the mailing list and following patch discussions be a good place to start? Is there anything else you'd recommend?

Thanks!
